claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened. Receipt and warranty card available.
claims.evidence: No receipt/warranty card photos; motor opening cannot be verified remotely; no new photos sent.

risks.risk: Microwave may not heat properly (magnetron/transformer issue) even if it powers on.
risks.proof: A short video of it heating a cup of water (show start and that it boils/strongly heats).
risks.if_unproven: Price it as not proven working (worst case: needs repair / unreliable).

risks.risk: Door seal/hinges may be faulty, causing failure to start or leakage risk.
risks.proof: Photo/clip of door seal area + a test showing it starts reliably with door closed.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as potential door/starting issue until tested.

risks.risk: Turntable/roller ring may be missing or not functioning.
risks.proof: Photo of inside cavity showing turntable/roller set + clip of it rotating while heating.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as missing/unknown accessories (worst case: not included).

risks.risk: Exact brand/model and wattage are unclear, affecting value and comparables.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the rating plate (back/bottom) showing brand, model, and wattage.
risks.if_unproven: Price it at the lowest likely spec for a generic countertop microwave.

risks.risk: Warranty/receipt may not be available or may not be transferable/valid.
risks.proof: Photos of receipt and warranty card with matching model/serial.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as no usable warranty.

proof_requests: Video proof: microwave heating a cup of water (start + heating result).
Photo of inside cavity showing turntable/roller set.
Photos of receipt and warranty card with matching serial/model.
response.reason: The seller’s text claim of testing is not supported by any new power-on/heating evidence or readable identification in the photos. Without the rating plate and a heating test, the correct spec and worst-case condition can’t be priced confidently.
